advice.title: Segl-a sõma la vɩɩmd fo yaab-yaab ne sũ-noogo
advice.subtitle: Sɩ ne yalg n tɩ ta lebg-n-waoong: bũmb nins sẽn na kɩt tɩ f sor-yalg Burkina Faso yɩ noogo.
advice.disclaimer: Kibay sẽn yaa gilli, gesg bala. Ges-a wakat fãa zĩ-sɩd-dãmba (Burkina Faso ambaasaad, fo tẽng yɩɩr-yɛlã minister, OMS) sẽn deng f kẽngre.

visa.title: Visa & pasapoor
visa.text: Pasapoor sẽn tar pãng kiis a yoob sẽn deng lebg-n-waoong rasem poore. Visa yaa tɩlae neb wʋsg yĩnga: e-visa online wall visa ambaasaadẽ. Bĩng fo sɛb foto fo telefõ pʋgẽ.

vaccines.title: Tɩɩm-lolo & laafɩ gũudum
vaccines.text: Fievre jaune tɩɩm-lolo yaa tɩlae (b geta carnet international f sã n ta). Sʋʋ-tɩɩm yaa sõma wʋsgo: kẽng vaccinations internationales zĩig semen a naas n tɩ ta a yoob sẽn deng f kẽngre. Toeem DTP, hepatites A la B, typhoide.

season.title: Wakat ning n kẽng
season.text: Wĩnd-wakat sɩ ne November n tɩ ta February: yʋʋm-wakat sẽn são n yɩ noogo. March-May: tʋʋlg wʋsgo (naoor wʋsg 40 C zug). June-October: sa-wakat, mogr yaa vɩʋʋg la sor-bila yaa toog naoor kẽere.

money.title: Ligd & yaood
money.text: Ligd: CFA franc (XOF). Yao ne ligd-peela zĩis fãa; carte bancaire tʋmda hotel bilf la Wagdgo bal pʋgẽ. Yiis ligd distributeur-dãmb tẽn-bɛd pʋsẽ la bĩng ligd-bila.

security.title: Lɛɛgengo & sore
security.text: Ges fo minister sagls sẽn deng f sor-tekr; zĩis kẽer pa são ye. Kẽn wĩntoog, ne sor-tʋmd sẽn yaa zĩ-kãngã ned la gã·d-zĩig sẽn bãng. Gʋls fo yʋʋr ambaasaadẽ f sã n tõe.

packing.title: Bũmb nins n pʋg valiiz pʋgẽ
packing.text: Fut-fãaad sẽn yaa faoge, zʋʋre, nin-lamse, wĩnd-tɩɩm sẽn tar pãnga, zũns-yood, tɩɩm bĩngr (sʋʋ-tɩɩm, sãoos-tɩɩm, koom-koom), lamp-lugre, adaptateur (prise type C/E, 220 V), koom-butelle sẽn filtre.

health.title: Pa ne laafɩ
health.text: Yũ koom butelle sẽn pag bal wall sẽn filtre. Zãgs glaas, zãad-mogd sẽn pekd ne robine koom, la rɩɩb sẽn yaa pʋg-pʋgo. Peg fo nus naoor wʋsgo. Kell n dɩ sʋʋ-tɩɩm wa ne ordonnance, baa lebg-n-waoong poore.

heat.title: Tʋʋlg & wĩndga
heat.text: Kell n yũ koom, ning yamsem bilf fo rɩɩbẽ, vʋʋs wakat sẽn tʋʋlg n yɩɩd (12 h - 15 h). Zʋʋre la wĩnd-tɩɩm wakat fãa. Gũus tʋʋlg yÃbdo (zug-zabre, sãoong-ratem, yam-menem).

customs.title: Manesem & mi·ese
customs.text: Burkina reegre (teranga) yaa noogo: dɩk wakat n pʋʋse, yaa tɩlae. Yel fut sõma, sẽn yɩɩd pʋʋsg-zĩis sɛɛgẽ. Tʋm fo nug-rɩtga n kõ wall n reege. Sok wakat fãa f sã n dat n foto ned.

bargaining.title: Koos-koos sã n ka yikri
bargaining.text: Koos-koos yaa mi·es raase la taksi yĩnga, pa bʋtɩk sẽn tar ligd-yaood ye. Kell n laade, togs ligd, bãng zems taab. Wʋm taab ne taksi ligd sẽn deng f rɩ.

connectivity.title: Telefõ & internet
connectivity.text: Ra carte SIM zĩ-kãngã (Orange, Moov) ne fo pasapoor, aeroport wall bʋtɩgẽ: data yaa faoge la couverture yaa sõma tẽngã pʋgẽ. Hotel wifi ket n yaa bʋgse. Telesarze fo kart-dãmb offline.

language.title: Buud-goam
language.text: Fransɩ yaa goam-kãseng la b wʋmda a sõma tẽngã pʋgẽ. Moore goam bilf (ne y windga) wall Zyʋʋla goam yaa noogo wakat fãa la pakda kʋ·le.

photos.title: Foto & waoogre
photos.text: Ra foto zĩ-sɩd wall sodaas zak-rãmba, wall aeroport ye. Sok neb yĩnga; barka-koaadg bilf yaa noogo. Zĩ-sõms kẽer pa sak foto ye.

emergency.title: Sõor sẽn tar yõodo
emergency.text: Polɩɩs: 17 - Bugum-kɩʋʋdb / lɛɛgengo: 18 - SAMU: 112. Gʋls fo ambaasaad sõor la fo assurance rapatriement sõor. Bĩng-b offline la sɛb zug.

healthWatch.title: Laafɩ gũudum lebg-n-waoong poore
healthWatch.text: Fo sã n paam tʋʋlg kiis a tãab pʋgẽ lebg-n-waoong poore, kẽng logtoɛɛg tao la togs fo sor-yalg Burkina Faso: sʋʋ tõe n wa yaool n puk.

feedback.title: Wilg fo sẽn yã
feedback.text: Bas tagsg gã·d-zĩis, sor-tʋmdb la rɩɩb-zĩis yĩnga: f sõngda sor-neb nins sẽn wat la zĩ-kãngã tʋm-tʋmdba tɩ b maneg-b meng.

itineraries.title: Sor-yalse sẽn sege
itineraries.subtitle: Sore BurkinaSira gʋlsdb sẽn maan: zĩis sẽn zemse, ligd gesg, sagls. Reeg nin-a f sẽn dat wã n toeem-a f meng yĩnga.
itineraries.note: Ligd gesg ned fãa yĩnga FCFA pʋgẽ, sẽn pa tar sil-yɛlgd tɩ loogd tẽns la viza ye. Yaa sɩngr zĩiga: toeem fãa yalg-teegẽ wã f sã n dɩk sore-a.
itineraries.highlightsTitle: Bũmb nins f sẽn na n vɩɩmde
itineraries.budgetHint: Gã·d-zĩiga, rɩɩb, vẽeg-vẽeg zĩ-kãngã, sor-tʋmdb la kẽebo. Sẽn pa tar sil-yɛlgd la viza.
itineraries.cloneNote: Naanda sor-yalg « Mam sore-yalse » pʋgẽ ne zĩis fãa. F tõe n toeema fãa poore.

nearMe.denied: B pa sak zĩig-bãngr ye. Sak-a fo teel-bũmb pʋgẽ tɩ f na ges bũmb nins sẽn be fo sɛɛgẽ wã.
nearMe.unavailable: D pa tõe n paam fo zĩiga masã ye. Makr-a-yã.
